runtime_status_panel_reference
Purpose: byte-level reference for the deterministic status overlay drawn after $1516 room rendering and before randomized $1E3A/$243E object placement.
Original authority: $1516 room renderer, $1CAB static/status panel, $1D3C draw-status-glyph helper, $1D4F pointer advance, $2319 score redraw, and $2345 life/target status redraw.
Scope: this stops before $1E3A enemy setup and $243E target placement, so no RNG-dependent objects are included.

status_glyph_draw_semantics
$1D3C stores the graphic id in $2F00, renders with store mode 2, decrements to store mode 1, renders again, then falls through into $1D4F.
For the even $0A40 values used by $1CAB/$2319/$2345, the final effect is a 24-byte cell clear followed by a copy of renderer record $2900+id*$18, then pointer += $18.
$2345 target-status draws subtract $38 from the advanced pointer after each collected slot draw, matching $238B-$2399.

port_rules
Use the composite digest table after validating clean room rendering; it adds deterministic status/score/life/room/level overlay bytes without randomized objects.
Preserve $1D3C's implicit fall-through into $1D4F. Treating $1D3C as draw-only will collapse status glyph layout.
Do not infer final visual names from glyph ids $20-$29 or $35-$38 here; this report only proves their renderer placement and bytes.
